crossRefs.note: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to…
You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for…
Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city…
He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and…
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

translations.web: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
translations.bsb: He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
translations.kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
translations.asv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, To this mountain, which his right hand had gotten.
